lineStatuses.reason: TUBE STRIKE: Piccadilly line service control staff are taking strike action from Friday 20 until Saturday evening, 21 November. Due to shared infrastructure around the Ealing Common District line depot, there will be no DISTRICT LINE service between Earls Court and Richmond / Ealing Broadway from midday on Friday until Saturday evening, with a reduced service on the rest of the line. No Piccadilly line service is expected during the strike. Replacement bus services operate during Friday Night Tube and Saturday daytime hours only. Please use MILDMAY LINE services between Gunnersbury, Kew Gardens and Richmond, where available.

lineStatuses.reason: TUBE STRIKE: Piccadilly line service control staff are planning to take strike action from Friday 20 until Saturday evening 21 November. Piccadilly line customers should complete journeys by 1030 on Friday morning as service will begin to reduce after this time. There will be no service from midday on Friday until Saturday evening, including Night Tube on Friday night. Normal Night Tube service is expected to operate on Saturday night. Due to shared infrastructure around the Ealing Common District line depot, there will be no DISTRICT LINE service between Earls Court and Richmond / Ealing Broadway from midday on Friday until Saturday evening. Replacement buses will operate during Friday Night Tube hours and Saturday daytime only. Please use ELIZABETH LINE services for travel between Central London and Heathrow, and METROPOLITAN LINE services between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge.
